description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Ice 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Stalwart Survivor Mode] and [10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Stalwart Survivor Mode
description.text: Casts Boost Morale when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: 10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 10% for the next attack
